corpus-14.translation: Which is better, your proposal or your colleague's PPT?

corpus-16.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? No wonder you post sunrise photos on your feed every day.

corpus-15.translation: Just look at that pretentious look on his face and you know something's up. That kind of deadpan nonsense is comedy gold.

errors.note: “故作高深”指装出深奥难懂的样子，pretentious 偏“自命不凡/做作”，语义略有偏差，但可接受。

corpus-18.translation: No thanks, go play by yourself.

errors.note: “不处”是拒绝处对象/交往，不是“不用谢/不必了”，译成 No thanks 改变了拒绝的对象和含义。

corpus-19.translation: Look, the lottery numbers I bought are exactly the same as the winning numbers you mentioned yesterday.

corpus-21.translation: On the subway, I ran into this guy who kept muttering anime lines to himself the whole ride.

corpus-27.translation: Isn't that how it should be?

corpus-20.translation: Hajimi north-south green beans, I'm holding back internal injuries at my desk.

errors.note: “哈基米”是网络流行语（源自日语“はちみ”/蜂蜜，常指可爱小动物），音译成 Hajimi 保留了发音但未传达梗义，属可接受的音译处理，仅提示术语处理。
“南北绿豆”是网络梗/无实义谐音串，直译为 north-south green beans 会让英文观众误以为是真实食材，意思传达偏差。

errors.span: I'm holding back internal injuries at my desk
errors.note: “憋出内伤”是夸张口语，指强忍笑意/情绪到内伤；直译 holding back internal injuries 生硬且易误解为真的受伤，不符合字幕口语风格。

corpus-28.translation: The boss is going to marry the cleaning lady.

corpus-24.translation: Not getting involved, the drama's too big to handle.

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不相处/不交往/不掺和”，译成“Not getting involved”偏离了原意，属于误译。

errors.span: the drama's too big to handle
errors.note: “瓜太大了啃不动”是口语化网络梗，译文偏书面、生硬，缺少字幕口语的自然感。

corpus-34.translation: At work, I'm always interrupted by all kinds of messages and find it hard to focus on what I'm doing. Are there any methods to improve efficiency?

corpus-33.translation: Watching post-00s chat in Martian language

errors.note: “火星文”指网络俚语/文字游戏，直译为“Martian language”生硬且易误解为外星语言，宜用“Martian text”或“internet slang”等更自然的说法。

corpus-31.translation: Oh man, I can't even, I'm gonna be laughing about this for a year. Come on, who doesn't have some embarrassing period pad buying story!

errors.note: “大家”是泛指的“everyone/you all”，译成“Come on”变成催促语气，与原意略有偏差。
名词堆叠生硬，英语更自然说法是“embarrassing story about buying period pads”。

corpus-40.translation: I can't even, happiness came way too suddenly.

表达偏生硬、书面化，字幕口语中更自然说法如“happiness came out of nowhere”，但意思无误。

corpus-47.translation: Can you stop dragging me into games all the time?

errors.note: 原文“那个啥”是口语化的模糊指代，译文添加了“uh, what was it”的填充语，属于轻微增译，但基本保留了不确定的语气。
原文“小潮team”中“team”为英文，译文将整个名称音译加意译处理，可接受，但若该团队有官方英文名应保持一致。

corpus-49.translation: I can't take it anymore, I know everything, I've been grinding so hard I'm going bald.

errors.span: I've been grinding so hard I'm going bald
errors.note: “肝到秃头”是夸张的网络用语，指熬夜/拼命到掉头发，译文按字面译成“grinding so hard I'm going bald”，意思基本传达，但“肝”作为熬夜/拼命的引申义未体现，略显直译。

ctx-01.translation: Don't worry, I've already memorized it.

errors.note: 原文是“我妈”（我妈妈）在说话，译文却用“He”，把说话人性别搞错了，观众会误以为是男性在说话。

m-003.translation: May I ask, did you just come out of the newbie village?

errors.note: “新手村”是游戏术语，英文游戏社区通常说 “starter village” 或 “starting village”；“newbie village” 能看懂但不够地道。

errors.span: May I ask, did you just come out of the newbie village?

errors.note: “主理人”在此语境指抖音上的账号/店铺主理人，译成“the curator”会让观众误解为博物馆策展人，意思明显偏差。

errors.note: 原文“加点啊”是让老板加（料/量）的意思，译文“add a bit more”缺少宾语且指向不明，容易误解为让说话人自己加。

errors.note: 原文“老板看了都得给你加薪”是泛指看到你的好运/福气，译文“after seeing this”指代模糊，且“this”在字幕中无明确所指，造成意思偏差。
直译“八方来财”略显生硬，不像口语化字幕，但意思可理解。

m-551.translation: Preparing for the teacher qualification exam—how should I get ready for the teaching ability test?

m-550.translation: No way, what's so funny about that?

errors.note: “不处”是网络用语，意为“不相处/不交往”（拒绝处对象），译成“No way”丢失了这层含义，变成单纯的惊讶。

m-552.translation: I want to find a light and heartwarming movie to watch this weekend, preferably one with beautiful visuals and a warm story. Any recommendations?

m-553.translation: I just started working out, and my muscles get really sore after every strength training session. Is that normal?

m-556.translation: Hey, I see you're so active in the comments—want to add me as a friend and chat?

m-554.translation: The boss said we can't leave until we finish these 100 pages of slides.

m-555.translation: Absolutely, bro, this has to be arranged!

errors.note: “arranged”过于正式生硬，口语中“安排上”更自然的说法是“count me in”“I'm on it”之类，字幕语气不够口语化。

m-558.translation: Why didn't you say so earlier? Hurry up and show us your moves!

m-560.translation: This streamer is clearly bad at the game yet has a million followers.

m-562.translation: There are plenty of fish in the sea.

m-557.translation: Read but reply randomly—just going with the flow.

errors.note: “已读乱回”指已读消息却胡乱回复，译文“Read but reply randomly”把“乱回”理解为随机回复，丢失了“胡乱、不靠谱地回复”的核心含义。
“随心所欲”译为“going with the flow”偏“随大流、顺其自然”，与“随心所欲”的随意任性语气略有偏差，且不够贴合网络口语风格。

m-561.translation: Alright, alright, I'll go line up right now!

m-559.translation: Afterthoughts: You're already crying from stress—life is just too hard.

errors.note: “观后感”指观看后的感想/评论，而“Afterthoughts”意为事后想到的补充念头，意思有偏差。
原文“急哭”是因着急/焦急而哭，译文增译“from stress”（因压力）改变了原因，属于增译。

m-563.translation: Fun fact: Douyin won't let you post the same photo twice, so this legend's album really does have a hundred "you're already crying with anxiety" pics.

errors.note: “你已急哭”是网络用语，意为“你急得都哭了”，译文加入“with anxiety”属于轻微增译，但整体意思基本保留。
“神人”译为“legend”偏口语化且略带戏谑，尚可接受，但“this legend's album”读起来稍显生硬，不够像自然字幕口语。

m-565.translation: Why did the person in this video suddenly switch to a different style?

m-564.translation: You're crying this fast, how are others supposed to wait in line?

errors.note: “crying this fast”在英语口语中略显生硬，更自然的说法是“crying so fast”或“crying that fast”。

errors.span: how are others supposed to wait in line?
errors.note: “how are others supposed to wait in line”作为字幕口语略显拗口，更自然的说法是“how is anyone supposed to line up?”或“how are others supposed to queue?”。

m-569.translation: Does this number have any special meaning?

m-566.translation: I sent a message to the wrong company group chat.

m-570.translation: Remember that building muscle is a long-term process. You'll see the fastest progress during the newbie gains phase in the first three months, so it's important to stay patient.

m-568.translation: My boss said my proposal reads like it was written by an elementary schooler.

m-571.translation: I can't take it anymore, you're flexing so hard I'm about to cry.

m-567.translation: These days young people really stand their ground during the New Year, unlike when we were kids and just had to quietly endure relatives' soul-searching questions.

errors.note: “支棱起来”指振作、有精神、有底气，不是“坚守立场/不让步”，stand their ground 语义偏差明显。
“灵魂拷问”指令人尴尬、直击痛处的追问，soul-searching 意为“自我反省”，修饰 questions 不达意，观众会误解为反省类问题。

m-572.translation: I can't even, hahaha, I'm so hooked.

m-573.translation: Isn't it too dangerous for this show to have elderly people perform?

m-574.translation: You think learning memes is easy? I have to binge-watch short videos eight hours a day just to catch up.

m-576.translation: My hand slipped while gaming and I used my ultimate in the wrong direction.

m-577.translation: Have you seen Li Zongheng's recent performance?

m-579.translation: It feels like a lot of people in the comments really want to show off their talent for being absurd.

m-578.translation: My roommate suddenly shouted "I want to check the cards!" in the dorm, and it completely confused all of us.

errors.span: I want to check the cards!
errors.note: “验牌”指查验/核实牌（如检查牌的真伪或点数），译成“check the cards”偏字面且含糊，未能传达“验”的核验含义，观众可能误解为只是看一眼牌。
“把我们全整懵了”是口语化表达，译文偏书面、生硬，不够像字幕口语。

m-575.translation: The pandemic took away all the positive cases, and everyone left is negative.

errors.note: 原文“阳的”是口语双关，指新冠检测阳性的人，译文“positive cases”把“人”变成了“病例”，丢失了“阳/阴”指人的双关，且与后半句“everyone left is negative”指人不一致。
原文“阴的”同样指检测阴性的人，译文“negative”未体现“人”，且与前半句“positive cases”不对应，双关和指代均丢失。

errors.span: took away all the positive cases
errors.note: “took away”较生硬，原文“把阳的全带走了”是口语化调侃，译文语气偏书面，不够像字幕口语。

m-580.translation: Take it seriously and deal with him.

errors.note: “当个事办”意为把某事当作正经事去办/认真对待，但“take it seriously”在此语境中略显泛化，且与“收拾他”搭配时，原文“把这件事当回事去办”的指令语气有所弱化。
“收拾他”是口语化的威胁/惩罚意味，“deal with him”偏中性、书面，语气不够到位。

m-584.translation: Pulling an all-nighter at the internet cafe, and suddenly I'm so hungry.

m-583.translation: Bro really got greedy this time, and the entertainment value is off the charts.

m-582.translation: Mom still gets you—you pause and rewatch every time you scroll past a handsome guy.

errors.note: “gets you”偏口语化且略生硬，中文“很懂你”用“really knows you”更自然贴切。

errors.span: you pause and rewatch every time you scroll past a handsome guy
errors.note: 原文“刷到帅哥就暂停反复看”是妈妈调侃对方的行为，译文用第二人称直述，语气从“妈妈懂你”的旁观调侃变成对观众的陈述，略有偏差。

m-581.translation: No problem, I completely lost it.

errors.note: “包的”是网络口语，表示“肯定/没问题/包在我身上”，译成“No problem”虽接近，但此处与后半句“心态直接崩了”形成反差，译文未能体现“打包票”的肯定语气，意思有偏差。
“心态直接崩了”指心理防线崩溃、情绪失控，译成“lost it”偏向“发疯/失控”，与“心态崩了”的语义不完全对应，且丢失了“心态”这一核心概念。

m-585.translation: The blogger got completely owned by a crazy pigeon and even started dancing to the beat.

m-586.translation: I can't go on anymore, I'm so exhausted I can't even walk.

errors.note: 原文只说“撑到走不动路”，并未明确说“精疲力竭”，属于轻微增译，但整体意思一致。

m-587.translation: All three have great displays, and the 120Hz high refresh rate makes videos look very smooth.

m-590.translation: Those content farm accounts are copying my ideas again.

m-588.translation: I don't dare speak loudly, for fear of startling the echo bug.

errors.note: “应声虫”是比喻盲从附和之人，译成字面的“echo bug”丢失了成语含义，观众无法理解其比喻义。

errors.span: I don't dare speak loudly, for fear of startling the echo bug.
errors.note: 整句偏书面、生硬，作为字幕口语不够自然，且“for fear of”略显文绉绉。

m-595.translation: The most awkward part is that there happened to be money in my bag.

m-589.translation: I can't take it anymore. This is my turf. On your knees, please.

m-592.translation: We don't call it working overtime and staying up late; we call it artistic creation.

m-593.translation: I'm preparing for the civil service exam, and I always struggle with the quantitative relationship questions in the administrative aptitude test. Are there any targeted ways to improve?

m-594.translation: That's a pretty sneaky way to put it. You're the first person to say that.

errors.span: That's a pretty sneaky way to put it.
errors.note: “太阴了这评价”指该评价本身阴险/刻薄，而非“表达方式很狡猾”，译文把评价的内容误译成了说话的方式。

m-597.translation: I sent a message in the group chat, but no one responded.

m-598.translation: You can use this feature by directly typing xnxf.

errors.note: 译文将“就能用”处理为“can use”，弱化了原文“直接输入即可使用”的顺承语气，但核心意思基本保留。
原文“怎么了”在此与“那咋了”连用，是反问/追问语气（意为“那又怎样？怎么回事？”），译成询问“发生什么了”的 What's going on? 改变了语气和含义。

m-600.translation: Got in touch with the ex again. Because of the baby? Can't even hold it in. Loves eating shit.

errors.note: “兜不住屎”被译成泛化的“hold it in”，丢失了“屎”这一具体所指，语义明显弱化。
原文“喜欢吃屎”为陈述，译文用“Loves”略加强语气，但基本达意。

m-596.translation: LMAO that's pure abstract art, this sleeping pose is way too artistic

errors.note: 原文“纯抽象”是口语感叹（意为“太抽象/离谱了”），译文将其具体化为“abstract art”，与后文“artistic”重复且略改变了原意。

errors.span: this sleeping pose is way too artistic
errors.note: “way too artistic”在英语中偏负面（“太过做作”），与原文赞叹语气不完全一致，可改为“so artistic”更自然。

m-602.translation: At least the first video didn't shove a pile of crap right in your face.

errors.note: “斤”是中文计量单位，直接音译为 jin 英文观众无法理解具体重量，应换算或说明（如 1.5 kg / 3 jin (1.5 kg)）。

m-603.translation: You save money on eyeliner and get a Western-style makeup look for free. I suggest you take a photo and post it on Moments saying it's the latest trendy makeup look—it'll definitely go viral.

errors.span: get a Western-style makeup look for free
errors.note: “自带”意为妆容本身带有欧美妆效果，译成“for free”略有增译/偏差，但整体可理解。
“朋友圈”译为“Moments”是微信官方英文名，尚可，但字幕中未加说明可能对非微信用户不够清晰。

m-606.translation: Slacking off at work and stumbled on a cringeworthy Moments post from a coworker

m-610.translation: You're only just now realizing that's the key point I was making.

m-605.translation: The team leader said we should solve problems ourselves when he's not around.

m-609.translation: I haven't bought an oven yet. Is there a simple recipe that doesn't need an oven?

m-607.translation: I urgently need a set of Shiba Inu emojis that capture the state of office workers.

m-611.translation: I really don't have time to mess around with you anymore, this ranked match is way too important.

m-608.translation: Sorry, but I'm so embarrassed I could dig a hole with my toes and wish I could move to another planet on the spot.

errors.span: I could dig a hole with my toes
errors.note: “脚趾抠地”是中文夸张表达极度尴尬的习语，直译成“用脚趾挖洞”在英语中不成立，英语观众无法理解其尴尬含义，属误译。

errors.span: wish I could move to another planet on the spot
errors.note: “on the spot”修饰位置含糊，且整句偏书面冗长，不像口语字幕的自然表达。

m-614.translation: Do you know the new WeChat name I just changed to?

m-616.translation: Such a random punchline, and I actually laughed out loud.

m-612.translation: At the same time, your company's XX culture (employee development, technological innovation, etc.) really appeals to me.

m-615.translation: Just got out of the shower and realized I forgot to grab a towel.

m-613.translation: The teacher asked me why I didn't hand in my homework.

m-618.translation: Please, art team, when are you going to give this goddess an outfit that actually fits her character?

m-617.translation: Hurry up and get online to play games with me, you're the only one missing.

errors.note: “就差你一个了”意为只缺你一人，译文“the only one missing”字面可理解为“唯一失踪/缺席的人”，略有歧义，但整体可理解。

m-619.translation: Watching your video on the subway and trying not to laugh is torture.

m-621.translation: Oh, you should've said that earlier. I thought that was called being real and unpretentious.

m-620.translation: Can we get the key points for this exam?

errors.note: “搞到重点”指获取考试重点/内部资料（口语化、略带打探意味），译成“get the key points”变成“获取要点”，丢失了“弄到/搞到重点范围”的含义。

errors.span: Can we get the key points for this exam?
errors.note: “搞到”是口语化说法，译文过于正式直白，缺少原句随意打探的语气。

m-623.translation: Don't even get me started, my wallet's about to be empty again.

errors.note: 原文“不讲不讲”是拒绝透露/不愿多说的意思，译文改成了“别让我开始吐槽”，意思明显偏移。

m-622.translation: Opening it again on your birthday is the best experience—if you open it now, there won't be any surprise left then.

m-625.translation: My mom is forcing me to go on a blind date.

m-626.translation: What should I do when video chats with my long-distance boyfriend often go silent and I can't find topics to talk about?

m-624.translation: What do you mean "no telling, no telling"? You awakened way too suddenly.

errors.note: “不讲不讲”是口语化的拒绝/回避说法，译成“no telling”偏向“无法告知/说不准”，语义略有偏移，不够贴合原意。
“觉醒”在此为口语调侃，直译为“awakened”略显生硬，字幕口语中不够自然。

m-629.translation: The boss said we have to work overtime to watch the surveillance footage.

m-628.translation: So what? Isn't that just standard for a relationship?

m-627.translation: You want it to be like watching the Spring Festival Gala?

errors.span: You want it to be like watching the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 原文“相当春晚看啊？”是感叹/评价语气（“简直像看春晚一样”），译文却译成疑问句“你想让它像看春晚吗？”，把陈述性感叹误译成询问对方意愿，意思明显偏差。

errors.span: You want it to be like watching the Spring Festival Gala?
errors.note: 译文句式偏书面、冗长，不像口语字幕；原文是简短口语感叹，译文语气不对。

m-633.translation: Working overtime until dawn, and my colleague says I'm just pretending to work hard.

m-630.translation: I've been wanting to start working out and building muscle lately, but I have no idea where to begin.

m-634.translation: Is it really mandatory to attend the weekend team-building?

m-631.translation: You're more of a keyboard warrior than any keyboard. Even a keyboard would look at you and say, "Now that's a real key right there."

errors.span: You're more of a keyboard warrior than any keyboard.
errors.note: “键盘”在此是双关/谐音梗（键盘侠、好键），译成“keyboard warrior”把调侃变成了字面意义的“键盘侠”，丢失了原文“键盘都没你键盘”的谐音趣味，意思有偏差。

errors.span: Now that's a real key right there.
errors.note: “好键啊好键”是谐音双关（好贱/好键），译文只取字面“a real key”，丢失了双关含义，且与上句“keyboard warrior”衔接生硬。

errors.span: You're more of a keyboard warrior than any keyboard.
errors.note: “more of a ... than any keyboard”结构生硬，不像字幕口语，且“keyboard warrior”是固定贬义网络用语，语气与原句调侃不符。

m-632.translation: When it comes to replying to read messages with random nonsense, I only trust Zhazha Hui and his grandpa.

errors.span: replying to read messages with random nonsense
errors.note: “已读乱回”指已读消息后胡乱回复，译文“replying to read messages with random nonsense”把“乱回”误解为“用随机胡话回复”，语义有偏差。
“渣渣辉”是网络流行昵称，音译“Zhazha Hui”可接受，但未体现其作为昵称的语感，属轻微术语处理问题。

m-635.translation: The cafeteria ladies this year are way too bizarre.

errors.note: “抽象”是网络流行语，指行为离谱、难以理解，译成“bizarre”意思接近，但“way too”偏书面、不够口语化，字幕语气稍显生硬。

m-637.translation: Can I pick a song first?

m-639.translation: My colleague keeps pushing work onto me.

m-636.translation: I almost burst a lung trying not to laugh on the subway just now.

m-640.translation: Make sure to check for these: a large dustbin (at least 450ml), an anti-tangle design, and a carpet boost feature.

m-638.translation: If you don't hand in your homework soon, I'm really going to have it out with you.

errors.note: 原文“再不交作业”强调“再拖下去就……”，译文加“soon”把条件限定为“很快”，语义略有偏移，但整体可理解。
“have it out with sb”偏书面/英式，指摊牌争论，作为字幕口语不够自然，且语气比“找你算账”略重。

m-641.translation: Got stood up three times in a row on blind dates.

m-643.translation: Coach, this yoga pose is way too hard. I really can't do it!

m-642.translation: Ideally something that's both funny and profound, with an ending that suddenly moves people to tears.

m-647.translation: My dad is still using the thumbs-up emoji.

m-644.translation: My kid knocked over a whole row of drinks at the supermarket, and when I said a few words to him, he started rolling around on the floor.

m-646.translation: Who among you can stay up later than me?

m-645.translation: These dishes are nutritionally balanced, low in oil and salt, and the best part is they don't require knife skills or heat control—high success rate!

m-648.translation: My friend uses memes all the time and I don't get any of them.

m-652.translation: It's best to keep it within 5,000 words.

m-651.translation: Absolutely, that's how precise big data recommendations are.

errors.note: “包的”是网络口语，意为“肯定的/没问题”，译文“Absolutely”虽传达肯定语气，但未体现原文口语化、俚语色彩，且与后句衔接略显生硬，属意思有偏差。

errors.span: that's how precise big data recommendations are
errors.note: 译文较书面、生硬，不像字幕口语；原文“就是这么精准”更口语化，可更自然表达。

m-655.translation: So what? Every time you say it's in the bag, it always goes wrong. Remember that video last time when you said it was in the bag and then dropped your phone into the river?

m-650.translation: I just saw a cat copying its owner doing square dancing.

m-653.translation: This teacher's open class was absolutely brilliant.

m-654.translation: My mom insists that I help her film a square dance video.

m-656.translation: Sneak out of work early while the boss isn't looking.

m-649.translation: The flagship T0 is indeed way ahead, with sales directly taking a huge lead as the undisputed number one.

errors.note: “直接”在此处是口语强调词（意为“直接就是/简直是”），译成“directly”显得生硬且语义偏移，应理解为程度强调而非方式副词。
原文“断层第一”指销量大幅领先、与第二名差距悬殊，译文用“undisputed number one”只表达“无可争议的第一”，丢失了“断层/差距悬殊”的含义。

m-657.translation: If the budget is lower, you could also consider an outdoor BBQ plus board games, which might keep the cost per person under 150 yuan.

m-658.translation: I'm about to go live and challenge myself to stay awake for 24 hours straight.

m-662.translation: Or... maybe "borrow" a top student's homework for reference?

m-659.translation: Said they hadn't studied before the exam, then went and got a perfect score.

m-660.translation: I wasn't going to make dumplings at first.

m-661.translation: Today's memes are way too abstract. I honestly can't tell what you young people are even into anymore.

m-663.translation: Turns out he's a hidden big shot.

m-665.translation: I forgot to cancel the auto-renewal.

m-664.translation: Aim to finish one essay within 18 minutes, and leave 2 minutes at the end to check.

m-666.translation: Can you help me check if this bag is authentic?

m-673.translation: Brilliant, that move was absolutely wild.

m-668.translation: What do you think about having a comedy blogger play the male lead in an idol drama?

m-671.translation: I can't even, you two are killing me, this is too funny

m-670.translation: Do you know what my dad's nickname was when he was young?

m-667.translation: Alright, let's treat this like a big deal.

errors.note: “彳亍”是网络用语，意为犹豫、迟疑或慢慢走，译成“Alright”丢失了这层含义，属于误译。

m-669.translation: I can't even, this is way too much.

errors.note: “I can't even”是网络流行语，与原文“我不行了”的感叹语气基本对应，但作为字幕口语略显随意、不够自然。
“太顶了”是网络俚语，表示“太厉害/太震撼”，译成“way too much”偏向“太过分/受不了”，语义略有偏差。

m-672.translation: I was shocked when I came across a video of your school's teachers doing livestream selling. Is the education industry really this competitive now?

errors.note: 生硬直译，字幕口语中更自然说法是“livestreaming sales”或“selling products on livestream”。

errors.span: Is the education industry really this competitive now?
errors.note: “卷”译为“competitive”基本达意，但语气偏正式，未体现“内卷”的过度竞争/内耗意味。

m-675.translation: Today after working out, I looked in the mirror and saw my belly is still one solid block.

“朋友圈”译为“Moments”是微信官方英文名，但未加限定，单独使用略显生硬，可考虑“WeChat Moments”。

m-924.translation: Wait until I get back to the country and handle it, then we'll see who's begging whom.

errors.note: “回国”说成 get back to the country 生硬且不地道，口语字幕宜用 get back home / get back to China。
原文“回国处理”是回国后去处理，译文并列成 get back…and handle it，略改变逻辑关系，但意思基本可懂。

m-923.translation: I want to set up a smart home at home, but I heard that devices from different brands may not be compatible. How should I choose to avoid this problem?

errors.note: “set up a smart home at home”重复冗余，字幕口语中显得生硬，可改为“I want to set up a smart home”或“I want smart home devices at home”。

m-928.translation: Okay, I'll talk to him later.

m-929.translation: Who's more attractive, your crush or your best friend?

errors.note: “你心动”指“让你心动的人/你心动的对象”，译成“your crush”把“心动”这一状态/动作误译为“暗恋对象”，语义有偏差。
“闺蜜”特指女性密友，译为性别中性的“best friend”丢失了“女性”这一信息。

m-930.translation: I thought it was a monologue, but it turned out to be narration.

m-931.translation: Can you really keep studying in this state?

m-932.translation: You didn't say so earlier! You really know how to keep things hidden!

errors.note: 语气偏正式、生硬，不像口语字幕；原文“我去不早说”是带惊讶/抱怨的口语感叹，译文缺少这种语气。

errors.span: You really know how to keep things hidden!
errors.note: “know how to keep things hidden”较书面、冗长，字幕口语中不够自然，且未体现“太能藏了吧”的感叹语气。

m-934.translation: You should've told me earlier, I missed the first release.

m-933.translation: Because you went from being the main character on campus to just a passerby.

m-936.translation: Have you heard of the Shanghai rich kids' flex?

errors.note: “沪爷”是网络俚语，指上海本地男性（常带调侃/自嘲意味），并非“rich kids”（富家子弟），译文改变了所指对象和语气。
“flex”偏网络俚语，与“冲击”所指的冲击/震撼感不完全对应，且整体语气比原文更随意。

m-938.translation: You should've told me earlier! I'm already seeing little people dancing now.

errors.note: 原文“我去不早说”是口语化的感叹，译文语气偏正式、书面，缺少原文的惊讶/抱怨口吻。

m-939.translation: I've been working for two years and want to switch jobs, but in interviews I keep getting asked 'why are you leaving your job?' How should I answer that?

m-935.translation: What should I do when my boss is gaslighting me and I still have to work overtime?

errors.note: “PUA”在此语境指职场操控/打压，译成“gaslighting”（心理煤气灯操控）语义偏移，且gaslighting通常指令人怀疑自身认知的心理操纵，与职场PUA（打压、画饼、情感操控）不完全对应。

m-937.translation: I can't even, that's so mind-blowing.

m-941.translation: So what? Who cares? These two paired together are absolutely perfect, the comedic effect is off the charts.

errors.note: “谁理你”意为“没人搭理你/谁管你”，译成“Who cares?”（谁在乎）改变了语义，且与“那咋了”语义重复。

errors.span: These two paired together are absolutely perfect
errors.note: “配一起绝了”是口语化网络用语，译文偏书面冗长，不够像字幕口语。

m-940.translation: Emma, I can't even, this is breathtakingly beautiful.

errors.note: “艾玛”是感叹词（相当于“哎呀/天哪”），不是人名 Emma，译文误作人名，改变了说话对象。
“我不行了”在此是“受不了/招架不住”的感叹，译成网络流行语 I can't even 语气偏轻佻，与“美到窒息”的强烈赞叹略不搭。

m-943.translation: Treat it as a big deal, and don't forget to bring a gift.

m-944.translation: Why did you steal my kill?

m-946.translation: You can agree to meet once a month to bring fresh energy into the relationship.

m-942.translation: The blogger shared some funny campus content, and that meme "it's really not appropriate for me to use yours" is way too real.

errors.span: 你那根我用确实不太合适
errors.note: 译文把“你那根我用”误译成“for me to use yours”，丢失了“那根”（那一个/那个东西）的指代，且“你那根”被简化成“yours”，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: that meme "it's really not appropriate for me to use yours"
errors.note: 把网络梗生硬地直译成引号长句，不像字幕口语，观众难以理解梗的含义。

m-945.translation: For this budget, I'd recommend a Wi-Fi 6 router—better signal coverage and stability.

m-947.translation: I want to start a fangirl emo venting group where we can talk about our idols and go crazy, only for girls born after 2000.

errors.note: “00后”指2000年代出生的人，译成“born after 2000”略有偏差（应为2000-2009年出生），但基本可理解。

m-949.translation: Why does my video get throttled as soon as I post it?

m-948.translation: Watching that video on the homepage where the celebrity claimed she's a size 36.5 but then got exposed—I'm dying laughing.

errors.note: 中文“36码半”指鞋码36.5（欧码），译成“size 36.5”在英语中易被理解为服装尺码，且中文“码”在此语境指鞋码，应明确为 shoe size 36.5。
“露馅”指谎言被揭穿，got exposed 偏正式/新闻语体，字幕口语中可用 got caught out 等更自然表达。

m-950.translation: Crying cat face.jpg, it's so hard for people who mishear lyrics.

errors.note: “空耳”指把歌词听错成谐音搞笑内容，译文“people who mishear lyrics”只表达听错歌词，丢失了“空耳”作为网络梗/趣味行为的含义，意思有明显偏差。

errors.span: it's so hard for people who mishear lyrics
errors.note: 语气偏书面解释，不像字幕口语；原文“太难了”是吐槽式感叹，可更口语化。
